items.name: 8_approver_tick_gaps
items.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
lines=open('/nfs/wangxi/tensor_eco/agent_work/auto_approver.log',encoding='utf-8',errors='replace').readlines()[-500:]
seg=[]
for ln in lines:
    m=re.match(r'\[(\d\d):(\d\d):(\d\d)\]',ln)
    if m: seg.append((int(m.group(1))*3600+int(m.group(2))*60+int(m.group(3)),ln[:22]))
g=[(seg[k][0]-seg[k-1][0],seg[k-1][1],seg[k][1]) for k in range(1,len(seg))]
big=[x for x in g if x[0]>300]
print('window_lines=%d ticks=%d gaps_gt_300s=%d' % (len(lines),len(seg),len(big)))
for x in big: print('  gap=%ds %s -> %s' % x)
PY
